messages:
lucy: quick heads-up  I'm updating the SDK snippets for streaming+pagination. Found three small problems: TS still shows `cursor`, Go retry has no jitter, and py example doesn't show cancellation.

omar: split into tiny PRs per language + one migration note. easier to review.

rina: i'll take TS and add both async-iterator + AbortController abort example. will update the pagination link to the new spec.

lucy: i'll do Python. plan: add `with client.stream(...)` example, show `.resume_token` usage, and include a short troubleshooting paragraph about prefix cache sizes.

o mar: (docs-bot) please keep code blocks wrapped under 120 chars.

o mar: zack, can you do Go? need context cancellation + jittered backoff with small randomness for tests.

zack: on it. will add tiny unit that bounds cumulative sleep so CI stays fast. example: sleep = 100ms*(1<<i) + rand(0,50)ms.

rina: opened TS PR #7021. included both styles and a compatibility blurb: "v0.9 uses cursor, v1.x uses resume_token." tagging @lucy.

lucy: opened py PR #7020, fixed link to https://github.com/redwood-inference/specs/pagination and added jitter decorator for retries. docs-bot flagged one lint line-length, will wrap.

zack: opened Go PR #7022 with test. pinging @omar for quick review.

omar: reviewed all three, small wording nits. please also add a one-page sandbox (migration note) that shows py/ts/go side-by-side. that helped last rollout.

rina: creating migration PR #7023 with sandbox and compatibility table. will request editorial from @omar.

docs-bot: (docs-bot) CI: #7020/#7021/#7022 passed link checks.

lucy: merged #7020 (py) after wrapping long line.

zack: merged #7022 after tightening jitter.

rina: merged #7021 then opened and merged #7023. added short "Timeouts vs Retries" FAQ.

omar: great work. closing out. ping if any regressions. :tada:
